purpose: Define a generic named network/service listener instance used by web, REST, OSC, WebSocket and other port-bound services, with stable logical identity separate from binding and runtime state.

topics.name: Listener Instance
topics.purpose: Define a generic named network/service listener instance used by web, REST, OSC, WebSocket and other port-bound services, with stable logical identity separate from binding and runtime state.

semantics.identity_rule: Each listener instance has an explicit stable logical name/identity.
semantics.binding_rule: Listen address, port and transport are mutable bindings rather than semantic identity.
semantics.state_rule: Declared, enabled, starting, running, stopped and failed states remain separate.
semantics.multi_rule: Multiple instances of the same protocol type may exist concurrently if bindings are valid/non-conflicting.
semantics.owner_rule: Listener owns binding/lifecycle semantics, not higher-level protocol/domain semantics.
semantics.authority_rule: Listener existence/running state does not grant operation/data authority.

invariants.rule: Listener/service identity is stable and separate from mutable listen binding, protocol configuration and runtime process/session state.

hard_gates.condition: listener identity inferred solely from port
running state treated as semantic identity

references.purpose: Listener belongs to explicit AIGMos instance/configuration.

prose.summary: Define a generic named network/service listener instance used by web, REST, OSC, WebSocket and other port-bound services, with stable logical identity separate from binding and runtime state.
